items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And me. So the only place I could sit would be between Caypart and Fats... when I got up there, they had Caypart and Fats and Big Jim

ctx.x: Yeah, Arthur Caypart. I don't know whether you know him or not. Light-skinned colored fellow that played decent trumpet; nothing to brag about, but a decent trumpet. And me. So the only place I could sit would be between Caypart and Fats, because I wanted to hear Fats myself. Boy, he was so pretty, he played so pretty, I couldn't imagine a cat playing that pretty.

And anyway, Andy said, 'Come on down front,' you know. So I went down in front and I played 'McGhee's Special.' And when I did that, Fats looked at me like that. He said, 'Man, how you do that?'
